title: tilia americana subsp. caroliniana
intro: Tilia americana subsp. caroliniana, commonly known as American Linden or Southern Basswood, is a deciduous tree species native to the southeastern United States. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and stress, improving sleep quality, and easing anxiety and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of American Linden are attributed to its ability to act as a natural relaxant, sedative, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can also help to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Tilia americana subsp. caroliniana include flavonoids, terpenoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
